metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Gordon Curbroll
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Gordon Curbroll is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as shocked pedestrian clipped at the crossing and lists crumpled shopping bag and clean shoulder wrap as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: That light was green for me.

records.name: Pippa Mirrorclip
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Pippa Mirrorclip is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as annoyed pedestrian with arm in sling and lists solid ivory sling and crooked rain hood as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: I was using that arm.

records.name: Drew Conecheck
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Drew Conecheck is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as dazed cyclist with helmet dent and lists smooth bicycle helmet with a broad shallow dent and cheek patch as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: The helmet seems to remember.

records.name: Alf Skidmark
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Alf Skidmark is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as indignant low-speed bump survivor and lists thick clean wrap on lower side lobe and single bent umbrella held close as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: I had right of way in principle.

records.name: Nell Brakebeat
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Nell Brakebeat is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as nervous passenger with neck strain and lists padded soft neck collar and a folded seatbelt strap held in hand as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: I heard the brakes eventually.

records.name: Bert Crossingwait
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Bert Crossingwait is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as relieved pedestrian with sprained side lobe and lists one short cane with broad rubber ferrule and a small ankle-like goo-base wrap as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: Next time I'll take the long way.
